title: Soul puppeteer
description: Ever wanted to manipulate any mob? Then try this.
body:
Adds a new way to trap monsters' souls and make them your own minions.

You can craft an _Empty Soul Bottle_ with one glass bottle at the middle and soul sand blocks around it, after that, equip it on your off-hand and kill any mob you'd like to enslave, wait for the cooldown and right-click it to summon your new minion!

Yes, you can make ANY mob your minion, from animals to hostile monsters and every boss!
